( 이후 안됨 ) - 옵션 선택 후 클러스터 생성 - AWS로 진행 ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/17397ef27e1f8dc4ecc8b5fec0ed678f6e723500/posts/229eda9b-0fe1-8055-9084-d4caa4cd4466/95a1fd1fe572cf4e.webp) - 생성 확인 ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/17397ef27e1f8dc4ecc8b5fec0ed678f6e723500/posts/229eda9b-0fe1-8055-9084-d4caa4cd4466/8b644168049cd8b5.webp) ### 2. Network Access 허용 > > > > > mongoDB에 접근 가능하도록 인바운드 규칙(IP 주소)을 추가한다. > > - 실습: 로컬 컴퓨터 IP 주소 > > - 베포: 베포 서버 IP 주소 ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/17397ef27e1f8dc4ecc8b5fec0ed678f6e723500/posts/229eda9b-0fe1-8055-9084-d4caa4cd4466/afb6543cea5c11b3.webp) ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/17397ef27e1f8dc4ecc8b5fec0ed678f6e723500/posts/229eda9b-0fe1-8055-9084-d4caa4cd4466/ee9de23956b8e61c.webp) ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/17397ef27e1f8dc4ecc8b5fec0ed678f6e723500/posts/229eda9b-0fe1-8055-9084-d4caa4cd4466/0b98fc5b5ca322c4.webp) ### 3. Database Access 허용 - 왼쪽 메뉴 - Database Access - Add new Database User ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/17397ef27e1f8dc4ecc8b5fec0ed678f6e723500/posts/229eda9b-0fe1-8055-9084-d4caa4cd4466/d444ef99076882ef.webp) - Database 유저 생성 > > > - Authentication Method: Password > > - username: 입력 필요 > > - password: 자동 생성 > - 처음 생성 시에만 확인 가능, 따라서 보관 필요 > > - Built-in Role: Read and Write to any database > - 상황에 따라 보안 scope 설정 > > - Temporary User: 인증 정보 유효기간 설정 ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/17397ef27e1f8dc4ecc8b5fec0ed678f6e723500/posts/229eda9b-0fe1-8055-9084-d4caa4cd4466/e0503145c70aed0d.webp) ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/17397ef27e1f8dc4ecc8b5fec0ed678f6e723500/posts/229eda9b-0fe1-8055-9084-d4caa4cd4466/2565c810a4d34c25.webp) - Access 유저 생성 확인 ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/17397ef27e1f8dc4ecc8b5fec0ed678f6e723500/posts/229eda9b-0fe1-8055-9084-d4caa4cd4466/08c39cecf5057388.webp) ### 4. DB 연결 - 왼쪽 메뉴 - Cluster - Connect 클릭 ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/17397ef27e1f8dc4ecc8b5fec0ed678f6e723500/posts/229eda9b-0fe1-8055-9084-d4caa4cd4466/4514c88826d5eb8a.webp) - 연결 유형 선택 ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/17397ef27e1f8dc4ecc8b5fec0ed678f6e723500/posts/229eda9b-0fe1-8055-9084-d4caa4cd4466/b48a27323e4fbfa0.webp) - Shell 로 진행 - mongsh 로 DB 연결 ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/17397ef27e1f8dc4ecc8b5fec0ed678f6e723500/posts/229eda9b-0fe1-8055-9084-d4caa4cd4466/6415274771bdd3dc.webp) ```bash # mongosh 설치 brew install mongosh # mongosh 연결 mongosh "mongodb+srv://subdev.kzmznlq.mongodb.net/" --apiVersion 1 --username subdev # 비밀번호 입력: 09uVKqfRQBenQPry ```
비밀번호 새로 발급 > ✏️ 비밀번호가 기억나지 않는 경우, 새로 발급 가능하다. - Database Access - 유저 대시보드 - Edit 클릭 ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/17397ef27e1f8dc4ecc8b5fec0ed678f6e723500/posts/229eda9b-0fe1-8055-9084-d4caa4cd4466/08c39cecf5057388.webp) - 비밀번호 새로 설정 ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/17397ef27e1f8dc4ecc8b5fec0ed678f6e723500/posts/229eda9b-0fe1-8055-9084-d4caa4cd4466/c0005e0d8ec560d1.webp) ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/17397ef27e1f8dc4ecc8b5fec0ed678f6e723500/posts/229eda9b-0fe1-8055-9084-d4caa4cd4466/884dde9e047dc8be.webp) - update User를 통해 수정해야 적용된다.
